name: devmesh
description: A provider-ready AI software engineering orchestration framework with Codex and ChatGPT adapters, Mission Control, one-prompt full-stack builds, Browser QA, security, CI/deployment, and a real-estate IDX/MLS specialization covering RESO Web API, listing sync/search, and display compliance review.

interface.shortDescription: Mission Control for evidence-based AI software engineering
interface.longDescription: DevMesh v0.8 adds a real-estate IDX/MLS specialization with RESO Web API/OData integration, Data Dictionary-aware mapping, listing synchronization/search architecture, and evidence-based IDX compliance review on top of Mission Control, full-stack builds, Browser QA, security, accessibility, performance, CI, production deployment, review, memory, reporting, and Git delivery. Codex uses the plugin adapter; ChatGPT uses the portable Agent Skills adapter.
defaultPrompt: DevMesh Mission Control: build this product end-to-end and judge the integrated result against evidence.
Use DevMesh to build or audit this real-estate IDX/MLS website using the actual MLS provider rules and RESO data contract.
DevMesh Incident Commander: investigate this production failure, stabilize it, prove the root cause, and verify recovery.
